aboutText: Roger has a strong passion for electrical work and commenced trading as Perfect Energy Pty Ltd, holding REC 18837. With a lengthy history of providing Electrical and Data Solutions across most areas of Melbourne, we specialise in serving Fitzroy North and surrounding suburbs. Our commitment is to deliver reliable, efficient, and safe electrical services to both residential and commercial clients. Available 24 hours a day, we ensure your needs are met with professionalism and care.
